notes: Today is Friday, 26 Jumada al-Ula 1448, with no major occasion in the next 7 days, so the Sadqah and kids Shorts are about Jumu'ah. Hadith checked against sunnah.com listings today: Sahih al-Bukhari 935 (the hour on Friday when dua is answered) and Sahih Muslim 854 (the best day the sun rises on is Friday). The sunnah.com pages couldn't be opened directly in this unattended run (no web-fetch tool), so the check used sunnah.com's own search results and the wording of both hadith.

Riddle order: there is no upload logged since 2 Nov, so Riddles #4 to #7 (3, 4 and 5 Nov) look unapproved. Today's video opens with Riddle #7's answer. Please approve 3 Nov, then 4 Nov, 5 Nov, then today, so they go up in order. Or hold today's if you'd rather pause.

Riddle #8: two fathers and two sons catch exactly three fish, and each takes home one whole fish. Answer for tomorrow: there are only three people (grandfather, father and son; the father is both a father and a son). No faces or people are shown in the riddle part, so the answer isn't given away.

All new stills are free Cloudflare FLUX images. A fishing shot with 4 people was dropped because it contradicted the riddle, and a kids' dua shot was re-rolled. The Masjid-e-Nabawi shots are the real Pixabay frames (credited), not AI. The kids video is Made for Kids, and the salutation uses your recorded clip. Comments: no new threads on riddle or sadqah. Nothing was paid.
